subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 7: /l/ (lip, lap, lot, lid); segmenting and blending; differentiates l and f

show.line: Listen. l, l, lip. l, l, lid! Lip starts with l.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with l, as in lid?
Say the sound with me. l, as in lap!
Listen. l, o, t. What word is it?
Is it l or f? Listen. Lap.
Does it start with l or f? Sort the pictures.

hints: Put your tongue behind your top teeth. l, l, l.
Say the sounds, then say them fast.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. l, i, d.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! l, i, d makes lid.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. l, i, d. Lid!

parent_line: Can hear the l sound and blend words like lid, lip and lot.
